lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid of high-luminance circular spots is organized in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spots transition from high-density clusters near the gills to wider spatial intervals along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a localized grid pattern where the blobs act as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, marked by sharp vertical luminance gradients with light-saturated upper edges and shadow-occluded lower boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark, elongated shapes (remoras) clustered around the ventral-posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
